result.instructions: Tools for MailBlaze, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "How many subscribers are on each of my mailing lists?"; "Show the open and click rates of my last five campaigns."; "Add jane@example.com to my newsletter list as Jane Smith.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes MailBlaze data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run mailblaze_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run mailblaze_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run mailblaze_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. mailblaze_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: mailblaze_list_lists
tools.title: List mailing lists
tools.description: List the account's mailing lists (name, uid, subscriber counts, defaults). Use the list uid in the other tools. Paged: page + per_page.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1 (results come in sets of 10; keep going until a page comes back empty).

per_page.description: Lists per page (default set by Mail Blaze).

tools.name: mailblaze_get_list
tools.title: Get a mailing list
tools.description: Get one mailing list by its uid: general settings, default sender, company details and counts.

tools.name: mailblaze_list_list_fields
tools.title: List a list's custom fields
tools.description: List the fields of a mailing list (label, tag, type, required). The tags (EMAIL, FNAME, LNAME, custom ones) are the keys used when adding or updating subscribers.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1 (results come in sets of 10; keep going until a page comes back empty).

tools.name: mailblaze_list_segments
tools.title: List a list's segments
tools.description: List the segments defined on a mailing list (uid, name). A segment uid can be used when creating a campaign.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1 (results come in sets of 10; keep going until a page comes back empty).

tools.name: mailblaze_list_subscribers
tools.title: List subscribers
tools.description: List the subscribers of a mailing list (sets of 10 per page; use page to go on). Contains personal data (emails, names).

page.description: Page number, starting at 1 (results come in sets of 10; keep going until a page comes back empty).

tools.name: mailblaze_get_subscriber
tools.title: Get a subscriber
tools.description: Get one subscriber of a list by subscriber uid (status, fields, dates).

subscriber_uid.description: Subscriber uid from mailblaze_list_subscribers or mailblaze_find_subscriber_by_email.

tools.name: mailblaze_find_subscriber_by_email
tools.title: Find a subscriber by email
tools.description: Look up a subscriber in one list by email address. Returns the subscriber (with its uid) or a not-found error.

tools.name: mailblaze_add_subscriber
tools.title: Add a subscriber
tools.description: WRITE, MAY SEND A CONFIRMATION EMAIL: add one subscriber to a mailing list. Depending on the list's settings Mail Blaze may send the person a confirmation (double opt-in) email. Only add people who agreed to receive your email. An email that is already on the list answers with a conflict error.

custom_fields.description: Custom field values keyed by the field's tag (see mailblaze_list_list_fields), e.g. {"PHONE": "+1 555 0100"}.

tools.name: mailblaze_add_subscribers_bulk
tools.title: Add or update subscribers in bulk
tools.description: WRITE, MAY SEND CONFIRMATION EMAILS: add up to 100 subscribers to a mailing list in one request; an email already on the list is updated instead. Depending on the list's settings Mail Blaze may send confirmation emails. Only add people who agreed to receive your email.

custom_fields.description: Custom field values keyed by the field's tag (see mailblaze_list_list_fields), e.g. {"PHONE": "+1 555 0100"}.

annotations.title: Add or update subscribers in bulk

tools.name: mailblaze_update_subscriber
tools.title: Update a subscriber
tools.description: WRITE: update a subscriber's name or custom fields. Pass the subscriber's current email (Mail Blaze requires it) plus only the values to change. Does not change subscription status.

email.description: The subscriber's email (Mail Blaze requires it on update).

custom_fields.description: Custom field values keyed by the field's tag (see mailblaze_list_list_fields), e.g. {"PHONE": "+1 555 0100"}.

tools.name: mailblaze_unsubscribe_subscriber
tools.title: Unsubscribe a subscriber
tools.description: WRITE: set a subscriber's status to unsubscribed so they receive no more campaigns from this list. By default Mail Blaze also adds the address to the account's local blacklist. Do this only when the person asked to stop (or a data-protection request requires it). The subscriber record is kept.

tools.name: mailblaze_resubscribe_subscriber
tools.title: Resubscribe a subscriber
tools.description: WRITE: set a previously unsubscribed subscriber back to subscribed so campaigns reach them again. Only do this when the person asked to be re-added (consent).

tools.name: mailblaze_list_templates
tools.title: List email templates
tools.description: List the account's email templates (uid, name). A template uid is needed to create a campaign.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1 (results come in sets of 10; keep going until a page comes back empty).

tools.name: mailblaze_get_template
tools.title: Get an email template
tools.description: Get one email template by uid (name and content).

tools.name: mailblaze_create_template
tools.title: Create an email template
tools.description: WRITE: create an email template from HTML (the tool base64-encodes it). Mail Blaze requires the HTML to contain an unsubscribe link. Sends nothing.

html.description: The full HTML of the email, including an unsubscribe link.

tools.name: mailblaze_list_campaigns
tools.title: List campaigns
tools.description: List the account's email campaigns (uid, name, status, dates). Use the campaign uid for details and reports.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1 (results come in sets of 10; keep going until a page comes back empty).

tools.name: mailblaze_get_campaign
tools.title: Get a campaign
tools.description: Get one campaign by uid: sender, subject, list, template, status and schedule.

tools.name: mailblaze_create_campaign
tools.title: Create and schedule a campaign
tools.description: WRITE, SENDS EMAIL TO PEOPLE: create a campaign for a mailing list (or one of its segments) from an existing template and schedule it for send_at. Once it goes out it reaches every subscriber of the list or segment, may use sending credit and cannot be recalled. Confirm the list, segment, subject, template and send time with the user before calling. Needs a template uid (mailblaze_list_templates) and a list uid (mailblaze_list_lists).

from_email.description: Sender address; it must be a verified sender in Mail Blaze.

segment_uid.description: Send only to this segment of the list.

send_at.description: When to send, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' (interpreted by Mail Blaze in the account's time zone).

tools.name: mailblaze_get_campaign_summaries
tools.title: Get campaign report summaries
tools.description: Bulk report summary (sent, opens, clicks, bounces, unsubscribes) for up to 50 campaigns in one call. Read-only (it is a POST in the API only because of the id list).

tools.name: mailblaze_get_campaign_inbox_breakdown
tools.title: Get a campaign's inbox breakdown
tools.description: Inbox-provider breakdown (e.g. Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo) of a campaign's delivery.

tools.name: mailblaze_list_campaign_events
tools.title: List a campaign's opens, clicks, bounces or unsubscribes
tools.description: List the individual events of a campaign by kind: opens, clicks, bounces or unsubscribes. Cursor-paged: pass the reply's next_cursor back until it is null. For very large campaigns Mail Blaze answers 202 with a job_id; check it with mailblaze_get_report_job.

cursor.description: The next_cursor from the previous reply, passed back exactly as returned. Omit for the first page.

tools.name: mailblaze_get_subscriber_activity
tools.title: Get a subscriber's activity
tools.description: Email activity (sends, opens, clicks, bounces) of one subscriber by email address, optionally limited to one list. Cursor-paged.

cursor.description: The next_cursor from the previous reply, passed back exactly as returned. Omit for the first page.

tools.name: mailblaze_get_report_job
tools.title: Get a report job's status
tools.description: Status (and result when finished) of an asynchronous report job, as returned in a 202 reply with a job_id.

tools.name: mailblaze_list_transactional_emails
tools.title: List transactional emails
tools.description: List the transactional emails sent through the account (uid, recipient, subject, status). Paged.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1 (results come in sets of 10; keep going until a page comes back empty).

tools.name: mailblaze_get_transactional_email
tools.title: Get a transactional email
tools.description: Get one transactional email by uid: recipient, subject, status and timestamps.

tools.name: mailblaze_send_transactional_email
tools.title: Send a transactional email
tools.description: WRITE, SENDS ONE EMAIL NOW: send a single one-to-one email to one recipient through Mail Blaze. It leaves immediately, uses sending credit and cannot be recalled. Give either html (the body) or template_id (a transactional template, with merge_tags covering every tag in it), not both. Confirm the recipient and content with the user before calling. Not for bulk or marketing mail; use a campaign for that.

from_email.description: Sender address; it must be a verified sender in Mail Blaze.

html.description: HTML body (the tool base64-encodes it). Omit when using template_id.

template_id.description: Transactional template id. Omit when sending html.

merge_tags.description: Template merge tags (required with template_id); every tag in the template must be present.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with MailBlaze
prompts.description: What you can do with MailBlaze here, with example requests to try.
